high_level_description: A single stylized cat in upright perched sitting pose, centered on a 1600x900 landscape canvas with pale sky background and narrow grass band at bottom.

compositional_deconstruction.background: pale sky occupying top 75% of canvas; grass band occupying bottom 13%

elements.desc: cat head: warm gray oval, centered horizontally, top-aligned near y=160
cat body: warm gray vertical oval, centered, overlapping head slightly at top
left ear: warm gray upward-pointing triangle base at top-left of head
right ear: warm gray upward-pointing triangle base at top-right of head
left front paw: warm gray oval resting on grass level
right front paw: warm gray oval resting on grass level
left rear paw hint: small warm gray rectangle near back underside
right rear paw hint: small warm gray rectangle near back underside
grass band: pale green horizontal strip with 14 short vertical grass strokes evenly distributed across width
